epic.title: Epic: CSV export for reports
epic.summary: Let report owners export any report as CSV from the report view.
epic.background: Customers copy tables by hand into spreadsheets; support gets several requests a week.
epic.notes: Requested in the product sync; no existing issue covered it.

criteria.text: Owners can export a report as CSV (derived)
Export button in the report view (derived)

criteria.deferred: Out of scope for this epic

tasks.title: CSV export endpoint
tasks.summary: GET /reports/:id/export.csv streams the report as CSV for its owner.
acceptance: Owner receives a CSV matching the report table

tasks.title: Export CSV button in the report view
tasks.summary: Add an Export CSV button that downloads from the new endpoint.
acceptance: Clicking the button downloads the CSV
